facts.fact: Stripe's cookie __stripe_mid has a duration of 1 year and is set to process payments.
facts.quote: Stripe sets this cookie to process payments.

facts.fact: Stripe's cookie __stripe_sid has a duration of 1 hour and is set to process payments.
facts.quote: Stripe sets this cookie to process payments.

facts.fact: The cookieyes-consent cookie, set by CookieYes, has a duration of 1 year and remembers users' consent preferences.
facts.quote: CookieYes sets this cookie to remember users' consent preferences so that their preferences are respected on subsequent visits to this site.

facts.fact: The Google Analytics _gid cookie has a duration of 1 day and stores information on how visitors use a website.
facts.quote: Google Analytics sets this cookie to store information on how visitors use a website while also creating an analytics report of the website's performance.

facts.fact: The Facebook _fbp cookie has a duration of 3 months and is used to display advertisements after a visit to the website.
facts.quote: Facebook sets this cookie to display advertisements when either on Facebook or on a digital platform powered by Facebook advertising after visiting the website.

facts.fact: The Microsoft Clarity CLID cookie has a duration of 1 year and stores information about how visitors interact with the website.
facts.quote: Microsoft Clarity set this cookie to store information about how visitors interact with the website.

facts.fact: The Google Analytics _ga cookie has a duration of 1 year, 1 month and 4 days and calculates visitor, session and campaign data.
facts.quote: Google Analytics sets this cookie to calculate visitor, session and campaign data and track site usage for the site's analytics report.

facts.fact: The YouTube VISITOR_PRIVACY_METADATA cookie has a duration of 6 months and stores the user's cookie consent state for the current domain.
facts.quote: YouTube sets this cookie to store the user's cookie consent state for the current domain.

facts.fact: The Cloudflare __cf_bm cookie has a duration of 1 hour and supports Cloudflare Bot Management.
facts.quote: This cookie, set by Cloudflare, is used to support Cloudflare Bot Management.

facts.fact: The Segment ajs_anonymous_id cookie has no expiry (never expires) and counts visitors by tracking whether they have visited before.
facts.quote: This cookie is set by Segment to count the number of people who visit a certain site by tracking if they have visited before.
